claim: For cold-start landing pages, brand-mean Beta priors (~160 pseudo-observations) beat uninformative Beta(1,1); text-embedding kNN does not beat brand mean once same-brand neighbours are removed.
definition: Leave-one-page-out measurement of prior information value across multi-page races.
caveats: Retrospective LOO, not online prior A/B.
Signal is brand identity in this sample, not design transfer via text embeddings.
